# Mahmoud Essam

> Product Design Lead and PM (محمود عصام) with 8+ years designing AI-powered platforms, ERP systems and B2B SaaS for enterprise and government teams across the Gulf. Based in Giza, Egypt, working across Saudi Arabia and the GCC. Currently Product Design Lead at Wakeb. Builder of Taskatk and BrandScan.

Mahmoud designs decisions, not just screens: UX strategy, complex flows and design systems for high-density operational products, with product management and business analysis in the same hands. He works with a few teams at a time and goes deep into the problem, the user and the business. 50+ clients, 6+ companies.

## Practices

- Product Design: UX strategy, complex flows, information architecture and scalable design systems. UX research, flows, wireframing, prototyping, design systems, IA.
- Product Management: PRDs, roadmaps, prioritising with MoSCoW and aligning stakeholders end to end. Product strategy, roadmapping, SRS and PRD, Agile and Scrum.
- Business Analysis: requirements, market mapping, competitive research, KPI definition and RACI matrices.
- AI and Workflow: human-AI interaction patterns, AI-assisted design workflows and prompt-engineered tooling.

## Experience

- Product Design Lead at Wakeb (2021 to now), Saudi Arabia, AI and data: end-to-end product design for AI-driven enterprise platforms for government and enterprise clients in the GCC; mentoring the design team.
- Design Director at PixellCode (2023 to 2025), Egypt and GCC: founded and scaled an agency delivering SaaS, ERP, fintech and marketplace products.
- Senior Product Designer at Node (2025, 6 months), Saudi Arabia.
- Senior Product Designer at Arweqah (2025, 5 months), Saudi Arabia.
- Product Designer at uxarabia (2024, 4 months), Amman, Jordan.
- UI Designer at AKANH Advertising (2021, 1 year), Saudi Arabia.
- UI/UX Designer, freelance (2019 to 2021), across Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the UAE.
